Suite after the pass: 89/89 green (run-c78143bd). Register amendment carried to the gate: req-test-lane now covers named individual tests (owner ruling mid-build). Live proof en passant: THIS submit was refused by the freshly built SE-C-046 until it carried an update - the hot reload and the guard both work in production.
